method: Each asset was generated in one separate built-in tool call; no CLI, stock image or placeholder fallback was used.
description_nl: AI-gegenereerde illustratieve gerechtfoto's voor de cateringwebsite. Dit zijn geen foto's van werkelijk geleverde gerechten.
shared_style_prompt: Generate exactly one photorealistic professional catering-catalog food photograph, landscape 3:2 composition. Show one LARGE rectangular brushed stainless-steel gastronorm buffet pan of the named dish, photographed from a 45-degree slightly overhead angle, pan rim clearly visible, generous catering quantity. Food dominates the frame and remains legible in a central crop; include the complete main food area inside the frame with modest background. Consistent warm natural soft light, neutral clean buffet-table background, premium realistic food textures and appetizing color, real photographic camera optics. No people, hands, text, letters, logos, branding, watermarks, collages, split panels, labels, individual plated portions, or utensils obscuring food. Do not create an isolated cutout.
